answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Work waits on the jetty until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the saffron of the next round. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The falcon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
